proposed_comments.title: Keep numbered shortcuts aligned with visible items

confidence.rationale: The preserved review fix demonstrates that iterating the full filtered list assigns Alt+number slots to off-screen items after scrolling, so visible cues and command dispatch can diverge.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep numbered shortcuts aligned with visible items

**Severity:** `high`

When a list is scrolled past the first visible results, the numbered cues and `Alt+number` dispatch must use the same realized, visible interactive items. The current implementation enumerates the full filtered list, so an off-screen item can consume a slot and `Alt+1` can invoke a command that has no visible cue. Please derive the target set from realized items in the viewport and reuse it for both cue rendering and dispatch, then add coverage for scrolling before pressing a numbered shortcut.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans target selection, cue refresh, viewport tracking, and tests in multiple files; no single safe one-file suggestion can apply it without coordinating those changes.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction spans target selection, cue refresh, viewport tracking, and tests in multiple files; no single safe one-file suggestion can apply it without coordinating those changes.

proposed_comments.title: Localize and unify CmdPal access-key resources

confidence.rationale: The current head restores new access keys with literals and duplicates the Filters resource contract, which can drift from localized XAML values.

proposed_comments.body:
### Localize and unify CmdPal access-key resources

**Severity:** `medium`

Please move the new Settings, Filters, and developer-ribbon access keys into the existing localized resource workflow and use the same resource value for both XAML `x:Uid` binding and code-behind restoration. Avoid maintaining separate `FiltersDropDown.AccessKey` and `FiltersDropDown_AccessKey` entries; duplicate keys can diverge across locales and make the restored mnemonic differ from the visible one.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction requires coordinated edits to multiple XAML, code-behind, and .resw files, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction requires coordinated edits to multiple XAML, code-behind, and .resw files, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.
